summary: Franklin County tower that OpenStreetMap maps as a lattice observation tower; no build date, height or current condition found in the sources checked.

evidence.supports: lattice tower of the observation type
site at 2 m (7 ft) above sea level
edit note calls the structure a communication mast

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Eastern US Lookouts page gives only name and county; OpenStreetMap gives tower type, construction and site elevation. Record elevation_m 2.0 matches OSM ele, which is site elevation above sea level, not tower height, so height_m is left out. The OSM edit note 'Add/modify communication mast' is a MapRoulette task label, not evidence of current use; a human should check whether a communication structure still stands on this site. Not listed on the NHLR or FFLOS Florida lists (checked 2026-10-21). Story is shorter than the 120-word guide target because the sources are thin; it was not padded. Research used one search over the per-tower cap.
